## Circular to all Licensed Corporations

## Securities and Futures (Financial Resources) Rules Enhanced Excel format of Proforma Financial return

In view of some recent minor format enhancements, please adopt the new Excel format of proforma  financial  return 1 for  submission  by  electronic  means  (including  submission  in electronic form on floppy disk) from now on.  For the sake of clarification, please note that only the Excel format of the financial return has been enhanced and no change has been made to  the  contents  of  the  financial  return.    The  first  financial  return  that  adopts  the  enhanced format should be for January 2005 (which will be due for submission on 21 February 2005).

The  minor  format  enhancements,  which  aim  to  facilitate  the  use  by  the  reporting  licensed corporations, mainly include:

1. Enhancing the print checksum program 2 .  Instead of printing the whole set of financial return,  you  can  now  select  to  print  only  those  forms  that  you  need  under  the  new program;
2. Additional rows have been inserted in Form 5 and 11; and
3. In Form 3, where more than one row share the same bank or credit type code, only one bank or credit type code is now required to be filled in.

The softcopies  of  the  return  and  print  checksum  program  are  now  available  for  download from the SFC's website:

http://www.sfc.hk (Under Intermediaries, Licensing &amp; Investment Products ⇒ Intermediaries Supervision Related Matters ⇒ Forms ⇒ Financial Return)

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Ms Lorraine Chan on 2842 7751.

Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission

1 Proforma format adopted for submission of financial return for the purpose of the Securities and Futures (Financial Resources) Rules.

2 To ensure data consistency, the print checksum program is used for printing the financial return that is to be submitted together with the electronic form of the return saved on a floppy disk (in accordance with section 56(6)(b) and (e) of the Securities and Futures (Financial Resources) Rules).
